Hi xxx,
We use age-related information to determine when teen safety protections should apply to ChatGPT accounts, to provide the right experience.
On August 11, 2026, these protections are scheduled to be removed from your account, and you’ll gain access to features and settings for adults.
If this timing doesn’t seem right, please verify your age.
To learn more, visit our Help Center.
— The OpenAI Team
